subject: Finexa intro & partnered account playbook (AWS)
messages:
From: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@amazon.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-08T09:12:00Z
Subject: Intro: Finexa (customer) — ask to coordinate AWS co-sell intro

Hi Tessa / Jonas —

Quick intro: I work on the AWS ISV partner team and have been working with Finexa (Samantha Reed, Raj Patel on this thread). Finexa is evaluating a LLM inference platform for latency-sensitive features across their payments and reconciliation flows. They asked for an intro to Redwood and are open to an AWS co-sell engagement.

Can we coordinate a short intro call next week to align on a joint account plan and what AWS needs from both sides to push this forward (MAM, sales play, initial architecture review)? Target outcome: align on next 30/60/90 day milestones and who owns which collateral.

Proposed attendees from our side: Tessa (sales lead), Jonas (solutions), Marissa (CS/enablement). From Finexa: Samantha (VP Product), Raj (Head of Infra). From AWS: me + Solutions Architect TBD.

Two quick slots we can propose: Tue 11/10 10:00–10:45 PT or Wed 11/11 08:00–08:45 PT. If either works, I will send a calendar invite. I can also attach a simple MAM template if helpful.

Thanks — Evan
AWS ISV Partnerships

--
Attachments: none in this message

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@amazon.com>, Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@finexa.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@finexa.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-08T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Intro: Finexa (customer) — ask to coordinate AWS co-sell intro

Thanks for the intro, Evan — pleased to meet everyone.

Samantha / Raj — great to e-meet. We are excited to learn about the Finexa use case and to map a practical co-sell path with AWS. The two proposed slots mostly work for our team; Wed 11/11 08:00 PT is the best for us. If Evan/Finexa need the Tue slot instead, ping me and we can flex.

I've attached a short mutual action plan template and a one-pager playbook that outlines typical co-sell asks we see (roles, deliverables, SI/arch involvement, initial pricing assumptions). For the kickoff, suggested agenda (30–45 min):
- 5 min quick intros & objectives
- 10 min Finexa product/context & success criteria
- 10 min Redwood approach & early architecture considerations
- 10 min AWS co-sell asks / MAM / next steps
- confirm owners and timings

Can you please confirm who from Finexa will be on the call and whether we should include an AWS Solutions Architect? Also, Samantha — any NDA or procurement constraints we should be aware of up front?

I will send a calendar invite for Wed 11/11 08:00–08:45 PT once everyone confirms.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Tel: +1-415-555-0123

--
Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (spreadsheet, 46 KB), redwood-aws-playbook.pdf (PDF, 220 KB)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@amazon.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-08T12:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Intro: Finexa (customer) — ask to coordinate AWS co-sell intro

On Mon, 2026-11-08 at 10:03, Tessa Morgan wrote:
> I've attached a short mutual action plan template and a one-pager playbook...

Thanks Tessa — that looks good. A couple of quick asks from the solutions side:
- Please add a checklist item for an initial perf/latency baseline (target p50/p95 token latency) so we can size GPU profiles correctly.
- Recommend including an optional "pilot scope" bucket for a small set of payment flows to reduce initial risk.

If Finexa's infra team can share a basic network diagram prior to the call (VPC layout, egress patterns, data residency limits), that'll help us prepare a short architecture sketch to show on the kickoff.

I'll prepare a short pricing delta slide (vanilla vs quantized/throughput-optimized) to discuss cost/ops tradeoffs — copying Karthik to confirm pricing owners.

Jonas
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: none

From: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@amazon.com>

Date: 2026-11-09T08:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Intro: Finexa (customer) — ask to coordinate AWS co-sell intro

Perfect — confirmed with Samantha and Raj. Wed 11/11 08:00 PT works for Finexa. We'll have an AWS SA (Priya Iyer) join as well. Priya will send a short architecture note, and Samantha attached a 1-page context doc for us to review ahead of the call.

Samantha / Raj — adding two brief context items here so Redwood can prep:
- Finexa is initially focused on real-time reconciliation that runs in prod (500 TPS spikes) and is sensitive to 99th percentile latency.
- Their compliance posture: SOC 2 in progress, data retention rules for EU customers only right now but they anticipate expansion.

Attached: finexa-architecture-notes.pdf (customer-provided, 3 pages). HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/987654

Evan
AWS ISV Partnerships

Thanks all — invite sent for Wed 2026-11-11 08:00–08:45 PT (calendar link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=example). Agenda attached again for reference.

Action items before the call:
- Finexa (Samantha / Raj): share any architecture/network diagrams and any procurement/licensing constraints (NDA, SSO requirements) — ideally by EOD 11/10.
- AWS (Evan/Priya): share suggested MAM fields and any marketplace listing prerequisites or timelines.
- Redwood (Jonas/Karthik): prepare a short architecture sketch + two pricing scenarios (pilot vs production).

We'll use the mutual-action-plan.xlsx on the call to assign owners. If anyone needs a different time, speak now — otherwise we'll proceed with the invite. Looking forward.

Best regards,
Tessa Morgan
